analysis.faq1Q: Why is the damage different from the game?
analysis.faq1A: The analysis uses current game data and compiled combat rules. Missing mechanics, spatial simplifications, version differences, and UI rounding can all cause differences. Check native evidence and simulation diagnostics for the rule involved.
analysis.faq2Q: What are the limitations of the damage calculation?
analysis.faq2A: The analysis only counts damage receipts produced by the formal simulation. It does not invent uncompiled behavior or missing conditions such as distance and target count. Reported simulation diagnostics can prevent some skills from executing.
analysis.faq3A: Undecomposed damage is counted as the attacker's own damage. External bonus attribution is not connected yet, so the contribution chart currently shows own damage; this does not mean teammate buffs have no effect.
analysis.faq4Q: How is the analysis range chosen?
analysis.faq4A: Counting starts at the scenario's simulation start and ignores earlier preparation damage. Rotation time ends at the last valid damage event. DPS is zero when there is no valid damage.

fieldHelp.eventStatusKey: Respond only when this semantic status expires or is consumed.
fieldHelp.handlerKey: Stable, readable identity of this handler within the skill, used by diagnostics and later structural references.
fieldHelp.eventCondition: Additional combat condition checked after the event matches. Failure skips this handler for the event.
fieldHelp.actionOperation: Assigns or transforms a value in this cast's action blackboard.
fieldHelp.cooldownSkillSelector: A type selector affects every matching skill of the caster; an ID selector affects only that native skill identity.
fieldHelp.cooldownSkillType: Selects the skill type whose cooldowns are adjusted together.
fieldHelp.cooldownSkillId: The stable skill ID to adjust, not its display name.
fieldHelp.cooldownOperation: Reduce subtracts from the current remainder; set directly replaces the current remainder.
fieldHelp.cooldownBasis: A base-duration ratio uses 1 for one full configured cooldown; absolute values are seconds. Reduce only supports ratios.
fieldHelp.cooldownValue: May be a constant or a value read from the current cast's action blackboard.
fieldHelp.calculationOperation: Calculates from two operands and writes the result without reading the output key's old value.
fieldHelp.resource: SP is shared by the squad; ultimate energy belongs to an operator. Each follows its own efficiency rules.
fieldHelp.dynamicResourceValue: The amount may be constant or read from this cast's action blackboard at execution time.
fieldHelp.resourceRecipient: Caster means the current operator; Team is used for squad-level resources such as shared SP.
fieldHelp.resourceCoefficient: Multiplied into the resource change before the efficiency chain. Empty uses 1.
fieldHelp.spGainKind: Distinguishes ordinary gain from refund. Refunded SP does not generate ultimate energy again when spent.
fieldHelp.spGainSource: Marks SP as coming from a normal attack, power attack, or skill so shared gain efficiency can choose its multiplier.
fieldHelp.percentOfMaximum: Interprets the amount as a fraction of maximum ultimate energy instead of fixed points.
fieldHelp.recoveryTag: Native permission tag carried by positive ultimate recovery. Some recovery blocks inspect this tag.
fieldHelp.ignoreGainMultiplier: Skips the target's ultimate energy gain efficiency and uses the current amount directly.
fieldHelp.statusKey: Stable internal status identity, not display text. Apply and consume steps must use the same key.
fieldHelp.statusDuration: Duration in simulation frames. Empty leaves the duration unspecified; per-level data edits only the current level.
fieldHelp.maxStacks: Maximum stacks retained after application. Empty keeps the status definition or runtime rule.
fieldHelp.consumeStacks: Number of stacks to consume. Empty uses the status's default consumption semantics.
fieldHelp.statusModifiers: Combat modifiers that remain active with this status. A status may carry multiple modifiers, compiled in list order.
fieldHelp.statusModifierKind: Chooses whether this modifier affects attack, susceptibility, resources, or cooldown. Changing it resets this item.
fieldHelp.statusPercentValue: Attack percentage bonus. Enter 20 for a 20% increase.
fieldHelp.susceptibilityValue: Additional damage received for the selected damage types. Enter a percentage.
fieldHelp.attributeScaling: Converts one caster attribute into additional susceptibility and adds it to the base value.
fieldHelp.scalingCoefficient: Susceptibility supplied by each point of the selected attribute, displayed as a percentage.
fieldHelp.susceptibilityCap: Caps the sum of base and attribute-scaled susceptibility.
fieldHelp.resourceCostMultiplier: Final resource cost multiplier. 1 is unchanged; 0.8 reduces the cost to 80%.
fieldHelp.skillGroupKey: Stable identity of the skill group whose cooldown is modified, not its display name.
fieldHelp.cooldownMultiplier: Cooldown duration multiplier. 1 is unchanged; 0.8 reduces cooldown to 80%.
fieldHelp.reaction: The elemental reaction to create or consume. Reactions and elemental inflictions are separate runtime states.
fieldHelp.reactionTarget: Applied reactions may target the caster or enemy; consuming one is fixed to the enemy.
fieldHelp.reactionDuration: Reaction lifetime in seconds, not the timeline block width.
fieldHelp.reactionEffectiveness: Strength coefficient used to calculate persistent or derived reaction effects.
fieldHelp.spellBurstType: The native spell-burst event identity to publish. It selects matching registered responses and does not create an extra damage hit by itself.
fieldHelp.markerId: Stable identity used to query the timed marker. Identical markers may coexist.
fieldHelp.markerTarget: Combat entity that owns the marker. A marker stores state and does not deal damage itself.
fieldHelp.airborneTarget: Combat entity receiving the airborne output. The dummy model emits the event without simulating displacement or control.
fieldHelp.markerDuration: Marker lifetime in seconds, supplied directly or read from the action blackboard.
fieldHelp.autoFinishByAction: Removes the marker when its creating action ends.
fieldHelp.skillCostCoefficient: Multiplies this cast's actual SP cost to produce squad ultimate energy.
fieldHelp.finisherFactor: Multiplier used by the finisher-specific SP recovery formula, not a fixed SP gain.
fieldHelp.finisherRecipient: Finisher recovery always enters the squad's shared SP.
fieldHelp.contextFlag: Stable flag name in the caster's combat context for conditions and mechanics to read.
fieldHelp.contextValueType: Values may be boolean, number, or text; changing type resets the current value.
fieldHelp.contextValue: Value stored under the flag. Readers must use the same type.
fieldHelp.contextTarget: The current model only permits writing to the caster's own context.
fieldHelp.timelineBlockFrames: Visible timeline width for editing. It is not the native action's natural end time.
fieldHelp.cooldownFrames: Simulation frames before the skill may be used again.
fieldHelp.costFrame: Frame where the resource ledger actually pays the skill cost. Empty uses the skill's default timing.
fieldHelp.costResource: Resource consumed by this cost. SP is shared; ultimate energy belongs to the operator.
fieldHelp.costValue: Amount paid. Per-level data only changes at the current skill level.
fieldHelp.sequenceStartFrame: Frame relative to skill start when this sequence runs. Same-frame sequences retain definition order.
fieldHelp.sequenceEndFrame: Explicit end boundary of this scheduled sequence. Empty means no explicit end frame.
fieldHelp.actionOperand: A direct constant or a value resolved from this cast's action blackboard at runtime.
fieldHelp.calculationOperand: Calculation input supplied by a constant or action blackboard reference.
fieldHelp.statusTarget: Entity that owns the status. Later consumption and modifiers act on that same target.
fieldHelp.buffId: Stable identity used for stacking, querying, and finishing Buffs. It is not display text or a global definition reference.
fieldHelp.buffTarget: Entity receiving the Buff. Party creates one instance for each operator.
fieldHelp.buffCount: Number of Buff instances created by this step, supplied by a constant or action blackboard value.
fieldHelp.buffSource: Source entity of the Buff, independent from its recipient. Empty inherits the current action source.
fieldHelp.buffSourceContextKey: Use the single previously queried entity as the source. Mutually exclusive with a direct source; no new operator lookup.
fieldHelp.buffDuration: Overrides the Buff definition's duration in seconds. Disabled uses the Buff's own rule.
fieldHelp.buffEffectiveness: Overrides the effectiveness passed to Buff mechanics. Disabled uses the default strength.
fieldHelp.inheritSkillCast: Copies the current skill-cast identity into the new Buff so it can track its source skill.
fieldHelp.buffAssignments: Initial values written to the Buff blackboard, overriding same-name defaults.
fieldHelp.buffManagementTarget: Entity whose Buffs are queried, finished, or held. Hold is fixed to the caster.
fieldHelp.buffQueryKind: Query stable Buff identities, or readable tag paths with a matching rule.
fieldHelp.buffIds: Comma- or line-separated Buff definition identities. At least one is required.
fieldHelp.buffTags: Select readable tag paths. Numeric IDs and numeric placeholders are not accepted.
fieldHelp.eventDamageTags: Matches damage tags carried by the event that triggered this response. Ordinary skill steps have no event context.
fieldHelp.eventDamageFeatures: Matches behavioral features carried by the damage event that triggered this response. Ordinary skill steps have no event context.
fieldHelp.damageFeatures: Behavioral properties of the damage, independent from skill classifications such as basic attack or battle skill.
fieldHelp.tagQueryType: Has requires matching tags; Except requires their absence. Any/All controls the combination.
fieldHelp.desiredKey: Numeric value key read from the matched Buff's blackboard.
fieldHelp.buffOutputKey: Action blackboard key receiving the result for later steps in this cast.
fieldHelp.finishReason: Lifecycle reason passed to the Buff, which may affect finish listeners and cleanup.
fieldHelp.conditionKind: Selects the runtime state to inspect. Changing type creates valid default parameters for that condition.
fieldHelp.scopeKey: Stable scope shared within one skill cast. Once nodes with the same key allow their body to run only once.
fieldHelp.branchKey: Stable skill branch identity enabled by forms, talents, or other build conditions.
fieldHelp.conditionTarget: Combat entity whose state is inspected. Endaxis currently models the caster and one enemy.
fieldHelp.healthValueType: Current health is an absolute value; current health ratio ranges from 0 to 1.
fieldHelp.returnValueIfPoiseMissing: Preserves native returnValueIfDontHavePoise: use this result directly when the target has no poise system.
fieldHelp.comparisonOperator: Relationship used to compare the left and right values.
fieldHelp.conditionOperand: A constant or a value resolved from this cast's action blackboard at runtime.
fieldHelp.objectTypeSelection: Select accepted object types or all objects. An empty list matches nothing. Enemy includes enemy parts; projectiles and ability entities are distinct types.
fieldHelp.minimumStacks: Disabled only checks presence; enabled also requires at least this many stacks.
fieldHelp.minimumLevel: Disabled only checks presence; enabled also requires the reaction to reach this level.
fieldHelp.buffStackValue: Total Buff stacks to compare. Scalar values are editable; dynamic operands remain read-only here.
fieldHelp.buffStackValueKind: Use a direct stack count or resolve the comparison value from a constant/action blackboard operand.
fieldHelp.conditionElement: Elemental infliction to inspect on the enemy. Physical normally does not form an infliction.
fieldHelp.operatorAttribute: Final build value of one of the operator's four primary attributes.
fieldHelp.healTarget: The controlled operator is resolved from the control timeline at the execution frame; equal health ratios use stable scenario order.
fieldHelp.healSource: Selects the entity used for output-heal events, healing bonuses, and source-side Buffs. The default is the caster or Buff source.
fieldHelp.healAttributeSource: Native healing formulas may read the attribute from the healer or the target; this is independent of target selection.
fieldHelp.healContextKey: Reads the operator identity saved by an earlier target query; healing does not select again.
fieldHelp.healAttribute: Primary caster attribute read from the current resolved panel for the healing formula.
fieldHelp.healMultiplier: Multiplies the selected attribute; it may vary by skill level or read this cast's action blackboard.
fieldHelp.healAddition: Flat healing added after the attribute multiplication; it may vary by level or read the action blackboard.
fieldHelp.healAmount: Direct healing that does not read a caster attribute; it may vary by level or read the action blackboard.
fieldHelp.healTags: Readable tag paths carried by healing events. Definitions, events and matching use the same strings.

stepHelp.switch: Evaluate the choice once and match options in order using float32 tolerance. Reset all branches; tick and end only the selected branch.
stepHelp.repeatByActionValue: Resolves a non-negative integer count from an action value at execution and repeats the body in native loop order.
stepHelp.mergeContextTargets: Merges stable target identities into a named action context group without spatial queries.
stepHelp.createSpatialPointTargets: Creates a named Context target group from a proven zero-space point source. Spatial points carry positions and are not treated as combat entities.
stepHelp.findCharacterTeamTargets: Queries the team at the execution frame and saves operator identities in Context; later reads do not select again.
stepHelp.findOwnerSpawnedAbilityEntities: Finds logical ability entities by the current operator and native GameplayTags, saving the full group and optional count in this cast context.
stepHelp.pickContextTarget: Picks one instance from an existing Context target group by stable index and saves it as a new Context target group.
stepHelp.forEachContextTarget: Synchronously executes one step sequence for each stable target handle already stored in the cast context.
stepHelp.readAbilityEntityRemainingDuration: Reads the finite remaining lifetime of the current iterated Context target into this cast's action blackboard.
stepHelp.setAbilityEntityRemainingDuration: Assigns the remaining lifetime of the current iterated ability entity using the proven native Assign subset.
stepHelp.finishCurrentAbilityEntity: Explicitly finishes the ability entity referenced by the current child timeline or iterated Context target.
stepHelp.finishActionOwnerAbilityEntity: Finishes the ability entity that owns this child-skill action, unaffected by a temporary Context target inside ForEach.
stepHelp.finishCurrentAbilityEntityWhenSourceDies: Finishes the current ability entity only after its source has been recorded as dead.
stepHelp.startCurrentAbilityEntityChildSkill: Starts an entity-local hidden child timeline on the existing ability entity referenced by the current Context target, without creating a player cast, cost, or cooldown.
stepHelp.startCurrentAbilityEntityChildSkillById: Starts an existing child timeline by stable child-skill ID on the ability entity referenced by the current Context target.
stepHelp.spawnAbilityEntity: Creates an ability entity from the definition embedded in this step, preserving its native identity, target, lifetime, blackboard, and optional entity-local child timeline.
stepHelp.applyElementalInfliction: Applies elemental infliction to the enemy for later elemental reactions.
stepHelp.triggerSpellBurst: Publishes the specified native spell-burst event and resolves registered responses with the current Buff source and skill-cast context.
stepHelp.triggerCustomAbilityEvent: Synchronously publishes an exactly named custom event on the caster AbilitySystem. The current subset only supports the evidenced caster-to-self target route.
stepHelp.castSkillDuringAction: Queues a registered native skill from the current action and inherits this cast context without charging its cost again. The native ID must resolve to one logical skill.
stepHelp.inheritSkillCastInfoForBasicAttack: Inherits the current cast information for a basic attack started during the action, preserving damage provenance without creating another player action or cost.
stepHelp.applyPhysicalInfliction: Executes the native FractureAction chain: creates No Guard first, then triggers Fracture when No Guard already exists. Both public Buff definitions are embedded at the use site.
stepHelp.applyElementalReaction: Directly applies an elemental reaction with duration and effectiveness.
stepHelp.consumeElementalReaction: Consumes a specified reaction on the enemy for follow-up effects.
stepHelp.dealDamage: Deals one Attack-scaled hit and may resolve stagger in the same step.
stepHelp.dealFixedDamage: Deals damage from a fixed base without multiplying Attack; later modifiers still apply.
stepHelp.dealStagger: Deals stagger only, with no health damage.
stepHelp.outputAirborne: Outputs one airborne fact and synchronously triggers listeners without changing dummy position or control state.
stepHelp.outputKnockDown: Outputs one knockdown fact and synchronously triggers listeners without changing dummy position or control state.
stepHelp.applyKnockDown: Root knockdown preserves guard breaking, status buffs, immunity and events. Standard scenario integration is pending; simulation is not yet supported.
stepHelp.heal: Heals an operator from the caster's primary attribute and records raw, actual, and overhealing even at full health.
stepHelp.applyBuff: Creates a Buff instance by looking up its ID in the owning object’s definitions and sets its initial blackboard values.
stepHelp.createGlobalBuff: Creates a battle-level GlobalBuff parent and projects its child Buffs onto every member of the fixed party.
stepHelp.finishParentGlobalBuff: Finishes the exact GlobalBuff parent linked to this child and all party mirrors in that layer.
stepHelp.finishGlobalBuffsById: Finishes every active GlobalBuff parent with an explicitly named native ID and all of its party mirrors.
stepHelp.readSkillSettingData: Reads a runtime-selected column from versioned SkillSetting data and may apply a recovered infliction-enhance formula.
stepHelp.readBuffBlackboard: Reads one value from a matching Buff into this cast's action blackboard.
stepHelp.readBuffRemainingDuration: Reads the remaining seconds of the first active matching Buff on the target into this cast's action blackboard; unlimited duration becomes 0.
stepHelp.readEventBuffBlackboard: Reads a value from the Buff instance snapshot carried by the current event.
stepHelp.readBuffStackCount: Counts matching Buff stacks into this cast's action blackboard.
stepHelp.readCurrentBuffRemainingDuration: Stores the current finite Buff's remaining seconds in the action blackboard; infinite duration becomes 0.
stepHelp.setCurrentBuffRemainingDuration: Assigns, adds to, or multiplies the current finite Buff's remaining seconds.
stepHelp.refreshCurrentBuffAttributeModifiers: Recalculates and replaces the current Buff instance's registered attribute modifiers from its current blackboard.
stepHelp.finishBuffsByTag: Finishes all Buffs matching a tag query.
stepHelp.finishBuffsById: Finishes all Buffs matching specified definition IDs.
stepHelp.inheritBuffById: Inherits an existing Buff instance attached to the current skill and hands that same instance to an allowed next skill.
stepHelp.finishCurrentBuff: Finishes the Buff instance currently executing a lifecycle or event response.
stepHelp.skillAffix: Records the owner's processing cast and ends this Buff when that skill ends. Ordinary provenance is unchanged. Derived-object reference retention is not yet modeled.
stepHelp.setCurrentBuffTimePaused: Pauses or resumes time for the Buff instance executing the current event response.
stepHelp.igniteBuffs: Triggers matching typed ignite responses on the target's active Buffs.
stepHelp.adjustSkillCooldown: Reduces or sets current cooldowns selected by skill type or ID, using a base-duration ratio or absolute seconds.
stepHelp.holdBuffsById: Prevents specified Buffs from ending while this scheduled sequence remains active.
stepHelp.restrictUltimateEnergyRecovery: Allows only positive ultimate-energy recovery with specified tags while active and may clear ultimate energy when it ends.
stepHelp.createTimedMarker: Creates a timed marker on a target; markers with the same ID may coexist.
stepHelp.setGlobalCooldown: Sets a battle-wide cooldown for a character. Reusing the same character and ID refreshes its remaining time. Independent of ordinary markers, character time dilation and action lifetime.
stepHelp.createAbilityEntityTimedMarker: Creates a timed marker on the current ability entity's local clock.
stepHelp.storeCurrentTimelineFrame: Stores the host skill or ability entity child skill's current local execute frame in the action blackboard.
stepHelp.storeEventSpGainAmount: Stores the actual SP amount carried by the current SP-gained event in the action blackboard.
stepHelp.storeEventHealValues: Stores the raw, actual, and overheal values carried by the current healing event in the action blackboard.
stepHelp.storeShieldValue: Resolves the action owner, then stores either the current event's shield gain or the target's live finite shield total. Leaves the blackboard unchanged if the target or required event is absent.
stepHelp.storeEntityPropertyValue: Reads a target's current health, maximum health, or stagger value into the action blackboard.
stepHelp.setHealthFloor: Registers a health floor owned by the current action lifecycle and removes it when the action ends.
stepHelp.modifyActionValue: Modifies a value in the current skill cast's action blackboard.
stepHelp.calculateActionValue: Calculates from two operands and writes to the action blackboard.
stepHelp.storeSourceAttributeValue: Reads a current combat attribute from the skill source and stores the native rounded and scaled result in the action blackboard.
stepHelp.changeResource: Changes SP or ultimate energy using a per-level amount.
stepHelp.changeResourceByActionValue: Changes SP or ultimate energy from a constant or action blackboard value.
stepHelp.gainSquadUltimateEnergyFromSkillCost: Converts the actual SP cost of this skill into squad ultimate energy.
stepHelp.gainFinisherSp: Restores shared SP using the finisher-specific rule.
stepHelp.recoverDashEnergy: Restores native dodge energy by the action value.
stepHelp.recordPerfectDodge: Records that this dodge succeeded as a perfect dodge.
stepHelp.markCurrentSkillCanDash: Marks that the current skill can now be interrupted by a dodge.
stepHelp.markCurrentSkillCanInterrupt: Marks that the current skill can now be interrupted by a following skill.
stepHelp.overrideMultiDashLimit: Temporarily overrides the consecutive dodge limit.
stepHelp.applyStatus: Applies an Endaxis semantic status with duration, stacks, and combat modifiers.
stepHelp.consumeStatus: Consumes stacks of a semantic status on the target.
stepHelp.jumpTimeline: Advances the host-local timeline to a frame. An optional condition is retried during the action interval, and the jump occurs only once.
stepHelp.finishTimeline: Ends the current host skill timeline immediately and discards every pending action.
stepHelp.reachSkillOperableBoundary: Marks when the next-skill window is reached. Only the executed branch determines the current skill block's end.
stepHelp.conditional: Evaluates a condition tree and runs the true or false branch.
stepHelp.once: Runs its body at most once within the same skill cast.
stepHelp.withActionBlackboardScope: Runs its body in the action blackboard owned by one native child-skill invocation.
stepHelp.repeatEachTick: Runs its body at interval start and on every subsequent host tick.
stepHelp.setContextFlag: Sets a caster context flag for other mechanics to read.
stepHelp.openComboWindow: Queues the next combo stage in the scene-level window runtime. The window lasts 5 seconds and follows queue order.
stepHelp.showComboRingQte: Registers a precise-link input window using the native warning and active durations.
stepHelp.changeSkillSlot: Changes the variant used by the next release of this stable skill group; an ongoing release keeps its snapshotted variant.
stepHelp.changePlayerActionMode: Changes the native command mode for one semantic player action and may restore the mode that was active before the step.
stepHelp.overrideBasicAttackMapping: Maps basic attack to a native skill while the Buff action is active, ahead of skill and mode mappings. Removed when the action ends.
stepHelp.changeNativeSkillType: Changes one skill's mutable native SkillType without changing its library group or player-action identity.
stepHelp.setCharacterPassiveUiValue: Updates the value shown by the character-specific combat HUD. This emits an auditable UI-semantic output without modifying damage attributes.
stepHelp.listenForCombatEvents: Registers temporary event listeners for the outer scheduled sequence interval. They are disposed when the skill ends or is interrupted.
stepHelp.startTimeDilation: Starts ordinary time dilation. Scope, duration, slot, priority, and curve determine the resulting clock scale.
stepHelp.startUltimateTimeDilation: Starts ultimate-specific global time dilation. The caster ignores it automatically and it stops when the action ends.
stepHelp.hideUi: Native HideUIAction interval. The normal branch controls ultimate presentation independently of time dilation. The input-only branch still requires the CommonMask protocol; this is not a universal skill lock.
stepHelp.setIgnoreGlobalTimeScale: Controls whether ability entities ignore global time scale for this action interval, reverting it when configured.
